name: Fifth Church of Christ, Scientist
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: classical neoclassical temple front with tall columns supporting a pediment, light grey limestone, central circular medallion above the portal. Street photograph (mapillary:3109998082508607) shows formal classical design — restrained form: front-centre dome tower, square chancel, stone walls, pediment front.

name: Third Baptist Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: pale limestone building with flat parapet top, restrained classical arrangement, rectangular openings. Street photo (mapillary:1321138285085144) shows clean formal design — plain parish church form: front-corner tower, gable front, limestone walls with square openings.

name: Unity
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: white/cream building with prominent pointed spire and smaller chapel structure. Street photo (mapillary:526300926063749) shows main nave with tall spire/steeple — built as gabled church with front-centre spire, white stucco.

name: Christ Episcopal Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: light blue wooden-sided or painted residential-scaled chapel with gable roof, simple rectangular windows. Street photo shows modest footprint — built simply: no tower, gable front, residential proportions, stucco.

name: Jones Memorial United Methodist Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: modern stucco church with clean geometric forms, tall plate-glass windows, skylights. Street photo (mapillary:1465706417801183) shows contemporary mid-20th-century design — built modern: flat roof, large rectangular openings, no tower, stucco.

name: Full Gospel San Francisco Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: reddish-brown brick building, simple rectangular form, flat/low roof, minimal detailing. Street photo (mapillary:25 m away) shows modest weathered brick — plain parish form: front-corner tower, simple openings, brick walls.

name: Missionary Temple
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: no photograph. Built plainly: simple rectangular chapel, white/cream stucco, flat front, modest proportions (8 m tag). No tower, plain opening pattern.

name: Sinai Memorial Chapel
note: tower() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: white/cream stucco building with arched round-headed openings, two storeys. Street photo (mapillary:36 m away) shows funeral chapel form with elegant proportions — built with tower() kit, not church(), per non-church institutional use. Refined white stucco tiers.

name: Love Chapel Church of God in Christ
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: small red brick building, minimal openings, very modest footprint (6 m tag). Street photo (mapillary:1183075105538081) shows converted storefront or simple chapel — no tower, brick walls, minimal detail.

name: Al Tawheed Mosque
note: tower() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: reddish-brown brick building converted to mosque use, multi-storey urban building (2–3 storeys) with large modern windows. Street photo shows contemporary storefront integration — built with tower() kit per non-church institutional form. Brick facade with multi-tier proportions.

name: Korean Methodist Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: modern white stucco chapel with contemporary architectural lines, large plate-glass windows. Street photo shows clean, minimal institutional chapel form — no tower, flat front, modern stucco walls.

name: Calvary Presbyterian Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: beautiful classical sandstone/limestone building with hip/mansard roof, two storeys with arched round-headed windows on both levels. Street photo shows refined classical proportions — major parish church: aisles, triple portal, rose window, limestone walls, plain buttresses, classical detail.

name: Seventh-day Adventist Japanese Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: yellow/tan residential-scaled building, two storeys, metal grillwork windows. Street photo shows converted residential structure — simple chapel form: no tower, gable roof, stucco walls, modest openings.

name: Hamilton Memorial Church of God in Christ
note: church() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: white modern chapel converted from retail storefront, simple glass and stucco facade. Street photo shows contemporary conversion, very modest proportions — no tower, flat roof, minimal form.

name: Soto Zen Mission Sokoji
note: tower() kit, sf/churches-5.ts: contemporary Zen temple with distinctive gabled roof, dark wood/timber frame, modern architectural language. Street photo shows low-rise elegant form — built with tower() kit per temple (non-church) form. Simple institutional proportions.

name: Mission Dolores Basilica
note: civic-center.ts: 1918 Churrigueresque basilica, white stucco and red tile, the crossing dome, the two ornate bell towers on Dolores Street (Commons). Was a generic block.

name: Saint Nicholas Russian Orthodox Cathedral
note: civic-center.ts: yellow clapboard Gothic church, the front tower and dark spire with its teal onion bulb (Mapillary on 15th Street).

name: Vogue Theatre
note: castro-theatre.ts: 1912 cinema, cream Deco front, the VOGUE blade, marquee and canopy (Mapillary on Sacramento).

name: The Masonic
note: masonic.ts: 1958 white Vermont marble box, glazed lobby behind twin globe-topped columns, Emile Norman's sculpture at the east end (Mapillary + Wikipedia); was a rule-7 chicago restyle.

name: First Church of Christ, Scientist
note: kit-churches.ts: buff-brown brick Romanesque, corner campanile (Mapillary); was a rule-2 classical restyle.

note: kit-churches.ts: limestone baroque, corner tower with a copper onion (churchofsaintagnes.org, Mapillary on Masonic); was a rule-2 classical restyle.

name: Saint Francis Lutheran Church
note: kit-churches.ts: Danish Gothic red brick, central wooden steeple (Wikipedia, noehill #39); historic census.

name: Chapel of Our Lady
note: kit-churches.ts: white stucco, red tile, the small white belfry on the gable (Mapillary on Moraga); historic census. Front is the bearing to Moraga's nearest point — the entrance side is NOT confirmed.

name: Swedenborgian Church of San Francisco
note: kit-churches.ts: 1895 Arts and Crafts, red brick and clinkers under red tile, the small corbelled tower, the arched portico on Lyon (Wikipedia, NRHP #04001154); historic census.

name: Konko Church of San Francisco
note: sheds.ts: the 1974 A-frame, blond wood, glass gable ends north and south (californiajapantowns.org); was a rule-2 classical restyle six storeys high.

name: San Francisco Central Seven Day Adventist Church
note: kit-churches.ts: 1892, pink stucco over red brick, the pinnacled corner tower, the arched brick porch on California (Mapillary, three frames); was a rule-2 classical restyle.

name: Old Sacred Heart Church (Church of 8 Wheels)
note: kit-churches.ts: tan Romanesque, round arches, the corner campanile; its front on Fillmore (Mapillary, 2026-10-05); was an sfapartment block.
